description: Stabilise a flaky test suite without touching the production code: one test asserts an exact outcome of an unseeded random sample, another depends on a scratch file a sibling test leaves behind. The gate runs the suite in four deterministic orderings/seedings and forbids skips and deletions.

criteria: Both flakes are fixed in the tests only - the exact-list assertion against the unseeded random sample is made deterministic (seeding or a property-based assertion), and the scratch-file dependency is removed (each test arranges its own preconditions) - with no test skipped or deleted, the production module untouched, and all four gate orderings green.
